newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL - HOUSTON'S BARKLEY AND DREXLER SUSPENDED, FINED.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL - HOUSTON'S BARKLEY AND DREXLER SUSPENDED, FINED.

text.p: The NBA suspended and fined Houston Rockets forward Charles Barkley and guard Clyde Drexler on Friday for their actions in a 115-101 home loss to the San Antonio Spurs Thursday night.
Barkley was suspended two games without pay and fined $7,500, while Drexler was given a one-game suspension and penalised $5,000.

Barkley appeared to head butt referee Jack Nies during a fourth-quarter argument over a call, leaving a cut on the bridge of the official's nose. Drexler, arguing in Barkley's defence, was fined for bumping Nies.
Both players were ejected from the game.
"We are not going to allow NBA players to put our referees at physical risk," said NBA senior vice president Rod Thorn.

"I don't think that Barkley intentionally tried to injure the referee, but when a player is waving his arms in a referee's face -- like Barkley did last night -- he will be held responsible for the consequences."
Barkley and Drexler will sit out against Miami Saturday night and Barkley will also miss the game against Milwaukee on Monday.
